thread:
Alex: Heads up — AWS sent a counterproposal for our GPU commitment. They propose a hybrid 'firm+flex' bucket with weekly reconciliation and a 20% burst credit. Need ops + legal to weigh in by Friday. TL;DR: flexible tranche, regional carveouts optional, availability credits for major outages. link: https://aws.example.com/edp/counter.pdf

Maria: Can you upload the PDF to the shared drive? want to skim before the sync.

Alex: Done: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-edp/proposals/aws-counter-1937654321.pdf

Owen: Quick read — headline concern: their definition of 'firm' is usage-derived. They only count a commit if average usage > 50% for the quarter. That's a soft floor and will leak value.

Sree: Agreed. We should push for a hard-guarantee tranche (min 70% firm) or automatic rollover of unused firm hours into credits at a fixed rate. Also insist on regional carveouts (us-east-1 + eu-west-1) — those are our high-demand pools.

AWS Rep - Evan: Happy to clarify: the hybrid we proposed is 70% firm + 30% flexible by default, but we can make the regional carveouts explicit in the MSS. Flexible tranche reconciles weekly; unused flexible can be burstable but not guaranteed. For preemptible/spot interruptions we offer a 1.5x credit multiplier toward the flexible tranche.

Jamie: We need explicit metering SKUs. Last EDP had gpu.shared vs gpu.dedicated mapping issues and a bunch of usage got misclassified. Please add "sku-level metering" in the contract.

contracts-bot: Reminder — internal redline deadline set to 2024-10-02 by legal. Please add comments to the shared redline: https://contracts.redwood/dev/edp/aws/1937654321

Maria: Ops — can someone run a 12mo committed vs actual usage projection with tails? We need break-even points for 60/70/80% firm mixes.

Owen: I can do a forecast but need the daily consumption dump. @Alex can you export the raw usage CSV to s3? one file per region preferred.

Alex: Uploaded a consolidated sample to the bucket and added a short snippet below. Full dump at s3://redwood-inference/fin/edp/usage-12mo-1937654321.csv

```
date,region,gpu_type,compute_hours
2024-09-01,us-east-1,A100,1245
2024-09-01,eu-west-1,A100,980
2024-09-02,us-east-1,A100,1302
2024-09-02,us-west-2,A100,1120
```

Sree: Also add a clause for reserved pool availability SLAs. Vendors often oversubscribe us-west-2; we should ask for availability credits (not only discounts) if reserved pool <95% monthly availability.

AWS Rep - Evan: For availability we can offer scaled credits: if reserved pool availability drops below 95% -> 5% invoice credit, below 90% -> 15% credit. We can add telemetry hooks for proof of outage.

Jamie: Important: include a reconciliation cadence and SKU-level reports (daily) as part of the EDP. No monthly blackbox statements.

Maria: Cost question — if we accept 70% firm + 30% flexible with their proposed pricing, what's the ballpark savings vs current on-demand? Ops/finance needs quick calc.

Owen: Preliminary calc: with average utilization ~65% and current spot/ondemand mix, a 70% firm + 30% flex mix nets ~18% savings on compute spend (assumes flexible discount ~12% and firm discount ~28%). If utilization dips below 50% we risk paying for unused firm capacity.

Alex: We should negotiate: (a) hard regional carveouts, (b) SKU metering + daily reports, (c) automatic crediting for preemption and availability, (d) 90-day lookback for true-up.

Sree: Also request an explicit on-ramps clause — if we grow >40% usage in a quarter they must give burst capacity or commit to capacity procurement schedules.

AWS Rep - Evan: We can include a procurement SLA for large growth events with a 30–60 day lead time commitment. For immediate bursts we'll offer best-effort within region capacity constraints and prioritized provisioning for committed customers.

Maria: Plan: Owen run the 12mo forecast + sensitivity for 60/70/80 firm mixes by EOD Thursday. Alex to prepare agenda and invite Evan + contracts + legal for Wed 10am PT sync. Ops to flag any red regions.

Owen: On it — will upload the forecast CSV to the same s3 path and paste highlights in thread when done.

Alex: Thanks everyone. Posting meeting invite now. :calendar:
